card.name: Verbs of giving treatment in overdose text
card.fires_on: Verbs like give, provide, administer, receive, or the word replacement that introduce a treatment or intervention. They appear in overdose management and adverse-reaction instructions.

modes.label: Overdose care verbs
modes.description: A verb of giving care right after an overdose or monitoring phrase, before supportive treatment.
modes.example: In the event of overdosage, observe the patient and<< give>> appropriate supportive treatment.

modes.label: Hormone replacement instruction
modes.description: The word replacement or including in the instruction to start hormone therapy for hypophysitis.
modes.example: Hypophysitis can cause hypopituitarism. Initiate hormone<< replacement>> as clinically indicated.

card.plain: It marks the verb that says to give or start a treatment when the label describes managing an overdose or a side effect.
